items.zh: 只装了 Codex 桌面版也能用 Codex 聚合模式
items.en: Codex aggregation now works when only the Codex desktop app is installed

items.zh: 读不到官方模型列表时提示写明原因，恢复后自动消失
items.en: When the official model list is unavailable, the notice says why and clears once it is back

items.zh: 获取模型列表时会带上供应商配置的请求头
items.en: Fetching model lists now sends the provider's configured request headers

items.zh: 深色模式的文字调暗一些，不再刺眼
items.en: Dark-mode text is softer and less glaring
